title: Gemma4 Agent Behavior vs Accuracy
subtitle: 1350 episodes + competitor lessons + LB lattice
description:
Companion dataset for Moran Zavdi's evidence-first retrospective "When Better Agent Behavior Does Not Improve Accuracy" (Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition).

Contains evidence/*.jsonl (1,350 episodes), scripts/reproduce_all_tables.py, notebooks/01-03, reports/lb_lattice.csv, LESSONS_FOR_COMPETITORS.md, stripped baseline configs, and figures.
